description: A Java class for rendering a list of colored triangles using OpenGL ES 2.0, including shader compilation, buffer management, and drawing routines.

classes.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
classes.description: Handles creation and rendering of a colored triangle list using OpenGL ES 2.0.

classes.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList.Program
classes.description: Encapsulates the OpenGL shader program, including shader compilation, linking, and binding uniforms/attributes.

methods.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the triangle list with vertices and color.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the triangle list using the provided Model View Projection matrix.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors after GL calls.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles an OpenGL shader of a given type with provided source code.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Sets this shader program as the current one for rendering.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the MVP matrix, vertex buffer, and color to the shader program for rendering.
